title: check_esm_upgrade_impact
description: Read-only upgrade check: which customized ESM screens and procedures (FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures) a release affects (targetRelease, default newest in the release change list), what changed, a risk level (High / Medium / Low) and a suggested action, as an Upgrade impact report card. includeStandard=true also lists components that are not customized. Reports only; a combined (merged) version is a suggestion for review and is never deployed without approval.

includeStandard.description: true to also list non-customized components.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
